designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Buenos Aires National Wildlife Refuge under the Endangered Species Act to restore the masked bobwhite quail.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Buenos Aires National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Buenos Aires National Wildlife Refuge Final Comprehensive Conservation Plan (CCP) (ServCat 118385): "The Refuge was established on August 1, 1985 ... to conserve (A) fish or wildlife which are listed as endangered species"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Established in 1985, the refuge was created under the authority of the Endangered Species Act.
